title: Cheshire Cat: pipeline escape to the Jenkins controller
description: A Jenkins controller builds the Wonderland/cheshire-cat repository from Gitea, and policy says builds run on dedicated agents because the controller keeps secrets on its filesystem. The controller's Built-In Node still accepts jobs: with write access, pin the pipeline to it and read flag5.txt from the controller's home (OWASP CICD-SEC-4 and CICD-SEC-5).
question: Submit the contents of flag5.txt from the Jenkins controller's home, read by pinning the cheshire-cat pipeline to the Built-In Node, exactly as recovered.
